# loop-spec

> A Claude Code plugin (8.x) that takes a coding request to a verified pull request.
> The model does the judgment, following one skill written as guidance; a small
> stdlib Python helper keeps the run's state and task graph, manages git worktrees,
> runs checks in a clean checkout, and opens the PR.

## The method

- [skills/loop-spec/SKILL.md](skills/loop-spec/SKILL.md): the whole method (spec, task-graph plan, parallel execution, verify and review, deliver), each phase's check, how to work, when to ask, and every program command.
- [skills/loop-spec/references/](skills/loop-spec/references/): what only some runs need: each run kind's changes (micro, debug, revise) and the PR template.
- [skills/loop-spec/references/visual-pr/](skills/loop-spec/references/visual-pr/README.md): the PR description format used when a repository has no PR template.
- [agents/implementer.md](agents/implementer.md): the Sonnet agent that implements one task in its own worktree.
- [agents/reviewer.md](agents/reviewer.md): the Opus agent that reviews the whole change against the spec, adversarially.
- [agents/simplifier.md](agents/simplifier.md): the Sonnet agent that looks for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups.
- Models: run the lead on Opus 5.5 for spec and plan and on Sonnet 5.5 from execute on; the agents' models come from their frontmatter. Through the Agent SDK that is [examples/sdk-plugin](examples/sdk-plugin/README.md)'s `--model opus --phase-model execute=sonnet`; switch once, since the prompt cache is per model.
- [hooks/hooks.json](hooks/hooks.json): the Stop hook that keeps an autonomous run going until it has a result, like `/goal`.

## Entries

- [skills/cycle/SKILL.md](skills/cycle/SKILL.md): a feature request or spec file, end to end.
- [skills/micro/SKILL.md](skills/micro/SKILL.md): a small, well-defined change.
- [skills/debug/SKILL.md](skills/debug/SKILL.md): reproduce a failure, fix the cause, keep a regression test.
- [skills/revise/SKILL.md](skills/revise/SKILL.md): address review comments on an open PR.
- [skills/status/SKILL.md](skills/status/SKILL.md): where runs stand.

## For contributors

- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): which part owns what, and the program's modules.
- [docs/models/README.md](docs/models/README.md): Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 behavior and what it means here; the source Anthropic docs are in docs/models/anthropic/.
- [skills/loop-spec/program/loop_spec/](skills/loop-spec/program/loop_spec/): the helper, stdlib-only Python >= 3.11.
- [examples/sdk-plugin/](examples/sdk-plugin/README.md): running loop-spec in a Claude Agent SDK session.
- [docs/migrating-7-to-8.md](docs/migrating-7-to-8.md): step-by-step move from 7.x (plugin, config keys, entries, SDK hosts), or how to stay on 7.x.
